outcome: Sessions are kept for thirty days rather than ninety.

acceptance_criteria.text: The retention window is thirty days and a session older than it is expired.

expected_verification.assertion: a session two months old is expired under the new window

acceptance_criteria.text: Removing the sessions that are now out of policy does not hold a single long transaction over the table.

expected_verification.assertion: the purge runs in bounded batches rather than one statement

data_impact: Permanently deletes sixty days of session records with no archive.
security_impact: Sessions are an audit trail; deleting them removes evidence as well as data.
rollout: Runs during the deploy that applies the migration.
